item.title: Sim2Real Rotary Inverted Pendulum

item.title: STM32 Custom MCU PCB

item.title: Project Mars — Autonomous Underwater Vehicle

item.title: Monocular Perception & Object Tracking
item.description: Built a real-time monocular perception and object tracking pipeline using OpenCV — detects, classifies, and tracks targets across video frames using depth estimation heuristics.

item.title: Barista Robot
item.description: Designed and programmed an autonomous barista robot capable of navigating a café environment, picking up cups, and delivering drinks using ROS 2 and a robotic arm.

item.title: EKF-LQR Inverted Pendulum Control
item.description: Implemented an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for state estimation combined with an LQR controller to stabilize an inverted pendulum under sensor noise.

item.title: ARRT Connect — Autonomous Robot Racing Team

item.title: TurtleBot3 A* Path Planning
item.description: Implemented the A* search algorithm on a TurtleBot3 for autonomous navigation in a mapped environment, including obstacle avoidance and replanning.

item.title: 8-Puzzle A* Solver
item.description: Built an 8-puzzle solver using A* search with admissible heuristics (Manhattan distance), visualizing the solution path and comparing search strategies.

item.title: About
item.description:
I am a Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer focused on bridging the gap between hardware and intelligent software. I recently graduated with a Master of Science in Robotics (May 2026), and my expertise spans from writing C++ perception pipelines to designing multi-layer printed circuit boards for automated manufacturing.

What I Do

I enjoy owning the entire hardware-software stack. Some of my core technical focus areas include:

  • Embedded Hardware: Designing multi-layer schematics and layouts in KiCad, managing power distribution, and implementing firmware for microcontrollers like the STM32F407VET6 and ESP32 series.
  • Robotics & Autonomy: Building multi-agent simulation architectures in ROS 2, Webots, and MuJoCo, and implementing closed-loop Field Oriented Control for brushless DC motors.
  • Machine Learning: Training reinforcement learning models (specifically Proximal Policy Optimization) in custom Gymnasium environments for zero-shot Sim2Real transfer onto embedded hardware.

My work is heavily hands-on. Recently, I had the opportunity to contribute to an oceanographic survey that deployed a microSAS sonar sensor on an autonomous underwater vehicle to capture sub-inch resolution acoustic images of the USS Monitor shipwreck.
